description:
Mission Control, we have a team! 🚀 We are tackling the Space Mission Design Game challenge for the Karachi Space Apps event. We're building an epic, interactive game where players experience the thrilling highs and nail-biting physics of launching real space missions.

Looking for passionate coders, designers, and visionaries to join our crew. Let's code, create, and conquer the cosmos together! 🌌
summary: This is a Space Mission Design and Launch Simulator that lets players plan and control a space mission. Players can customise spacecraft, prepare rockets for launch, perform safety checks, and complete space mission objectives.
details:
Our project is a Space Mission Design and Launch Simulator that lets players plan and control a space mission. Players can customise spacecraft, prepare rockets for launch, perform safety checks, and complete space mission objectives. We created this game to make young astro-enthusiasts learning about space and Space Mission design more interactive. We made effective use of several languages like Three.JS, HTML, CSS, and Super-Intelligence (Sonnet 5.5, Gemini Argon) for problem-solving and debugging code errors, as well as mentors who helped us by brainstorming and research throughout the project. We considered the Mission design hurdles that come during the launch of the spacecraft, such as telemetry, air, and gravity behaviour.

Used GitHub for Version Control and Documentation: https://github.com/teamexovyra/NASA-Space-App-Challenge
